column1: # Exact nonzero counts keyed by parsed syntax form and source path.
# Retirement stages are checked against canonical_stage() and cannot be edited
# independently of the Stage 1-5 cutover dependency map.
# signature-application rows: one reviewed count per (enclosing function, file)
# for every call of an argument-check primitive under hew-types/src/. Callees are
# reduced through the parse, so method, UFCS, fully-pathed, parenthesized and
# comment-separated spellings all count, and the primitive in argument or value
# position does not. It DETECTS: a call in a function not listed here, and an
# extra call inside a function that is. It does NOT detect a net-zero relocation
# — moving a call between two already-listed functions changes no total when the
# two counts move by the same amount in opposite directions. Accepted residual:
# closing it needs per-call-site identity, which byte offsets cannot supply
# without churning on every unrelated edit above the site.
